paragraphs.text: 1. INSTRUCT me, all ye Gods, how I, elected your Priest, must seat me here, and how address you.
paragraphs.original: विश्वे देवाः शास्तन मा यथेह होता वृतो मनवै यन्निषद्य ।
paragraphs.translit: viśve devāḥ śāstana mā yatheha hotā vṛto manavai yanniṣadya |

paragraphs.text: Instruct me how to deal to each his portion, and by what ' path to bring you man's oblation.
paragraphs.original: प्र मे ब्रूत भागधेयं यथा वो येन पथा हव्यमा वो वहानि
paragraphs.translit: pra me brūta bhāgadheyaṃ yathā vo yena pathā havyamā vo vahāni

paragraphs.text: 2. I sit as Priest most skilled in sacrificing: the Maruts and all Deities impel me.
paragraphs.original: अहं होता न्यसीदं यजीयान्विश्वे देवा मरुतो मा जुनन्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ hotā nyasīdaṃ yajīyānviśve devā maruto mā junanti |

paragraphs.text: Asvins, each day yours is the Adhvaryu's duty: Brahman and wood are here: 'tis yours to offer.
3. Who is the Priest? Is he the Priest of Yama? On whom is thrust this God-appointed honour?
paragraphs.original: अयं यो होता किरु स यमस्य कमप्यूहे यत्समञ्जन्ति देवाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ yo hotā kiru sa yamasya kamapyūhe yatsamañjanti devāḥ |

paragraphs.text: He springs to life each month, each day that passes; so Gods have made him their oblation-bearer.
4. The Gods have made me bearer of oblations, who slipped away and passed through many troubles.
paragraphs.original: मां देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहमपम्लुक्तं बहु कृच्छ्रा चरन्तम् ।
paragraphs.translit: māṃ devā dadhire havyavāhamapamluktaṃ bahu kṛcchrā carantam |

paragraphs.text: Wise Agni shall ordain for us the worship, whether five-wayed, threefold, or seven-threaded.
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्विद्वान्यज्ञं नः कल्पयाति पञ्चयामं त्रिवृतं सप्ततन्तुम्
paragraphs.translit: agnirvidvānyajñaṃ naḥ kalpayāti pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum

paragraphs.text: 5. So will I win you strength and life for ever. O Gods, that I may give you room and freedom.
paragraphs.original: आ वो यक्ष्यमृतत्वं सुवीरं यथा वो देवा वरिवः कराणि ।
paragraphs.translit: ā vo yakṣyamṛtatvaṃ suvīraṃ yathā vo devā varivaḥ karāṇi |

paragraphs.text: To Indra's arms would I consign the thunder; in all these battles shall he then be victor.
paragraphs.original: आ बाह्वोर्वज्रमिन्द्रस्य धेयामथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयाति
paragraphs.translit: ā bāhvorvajramindrasya dheyāmathemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāti

paragraphs.text: 6. The Deities three hundred and thirty-nine, have served and honoured Agni,
paragraphs.original: त्रीणि शता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन् ।
paragraphs.translit: trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan |

paragraphs.text: Strewn sacred grass, anointed him with butter, and seated him as Priest, the Gods' Invoker.
